description:
Take screenshots of any public website from Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, or any MCP client. 
The take_screenshot tool renders a URL and returns the image inline, plus a hosted link and the page title and description.
It supports full-page capture, a wait delay before capturing, and a timeout. 
You bring your own ScreenshotRender API key (starts with sr-), available at screenshotrender.com

findings.title: Excessive Permission Surface
findings.recommendation: Tool requests broad permissions (exec/fs/network). Validate input parameters using Enums where possible, and restrict file system operations to explicit allowed directories.

findings.title: DEPENDENCY_INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE
findings.description: Tool did not expose metadata.dependencies or repo_url, so supply-chain coverage is limited.
findings.recommendation: Review and remediate the identified issue.

tool_contexts.dependency_note: No metadata.dependencies or repo_url were exposed by this MCP server.
